commit_message: Route Managed Local AI through Goose ACP
pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate common ACP transport, AgentHost bridge, Claude/Codex/Goose adapters
- route first-class AI Studio agent Ask and Build through ACP
- route normal Managed Local AI sessions through the Goose ACP adapter while keeping current ADR 0156 benchmark children on their frozen Native lane until benchmark migration
- preserve AgentHost-selected project-root/read-only and isolated-workspace/run-bound working directories
- align the ACP MCP server name with the stable `gameengine_editor` namespace
- map AI Studio quality to Codex ACP reasoning effort and refresh machine-local runtime registrations when settings change
- include external runtime process authority in normal Build capability budgets

## Integration

Benchmark migration, Cargo.lock generation, final Windows Validation, and any required final visual checks remain.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required; final integrated-head validation remains authoritative.
